chapter: Hutto 1978-79: Specht, Weems and learning to play
title: Xylophone and vibraphone
summary: He started on a small xylophone, then took up vibraphone and xylophone seriously when he joined NBC and studied with the best teacher in New York.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Learning your horn: teachers, lessons and fees

blocks.x: Now say the vibraphone, did you play the xylophone or the vibraphone? Was it around at that time?
No, I didn't...I had a little xylophone about this long. And I used to pick out little easy things to play on that.
So you were self taught more or less on that.
Tick tick tick tick tock, ticka ticka ticka tock, you know. But I took up the vibraphone and the
xylophone when I went to NBC, to be the drummer at NBC. And that taught me a helluva lot. And I went to the best teacher in New York.
